justification: Although some applicants raise Article 11 complaints concerning public assemblies, the Court's standalone merits finding is under Article 6 § 1 (lack of impartiality), and the Article 11 complaints are disposed of only summarily by reference to well-established case-law in a single line without a separate, substantive Article 11 merits analysis or operative holding — the Article 11 finding is subsumed within a catch-all paragraph rather than constituting a genuine standalone Article 11 adjudication.
